subject: Life Skills
title: The Three Conversations Model
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Three Conversations Model.

hook.text: Harvard's Difficult Conversations book reveals every hard talk is actually three conversations stacked together.

buildup.text: The first is about what happened: the facts and events each person saw differently.

discovery.text: The second is about feelings: the emotions triggered by those events, often unspoken.

twist.text: The third is about identity: what the situation says about who I am. This one drives the most resistance.

climax.text: Address all three layers. Skipping feelings or identity leaves the real conflict buried and unresolved.

punchline.text: Facts, feelings, identity. Address all three layers.

quiz.question: Which of the three conversations typically drives the most resistance?
options: The conversation about facts and events
The conversation about identity and self-image
